stem: Source-water EC rises substantially compared with its normal baseline before nutrients are mixed. What is the best reason to investigate before using the usual feed recipe unchanged?
choices: The source now contributes more dissolved ions to the final solution
The higher source EC may change the final solution slightly, but the usual nutrient recipe should remain the primary reference for interpreting the feed
The change may reflect one or more dissolved minerals, so the first step is to identify which ion increased before considering the total solution
Source-water EC matters mainly when pH also changes, because otherwise the added dissolved ions have limited effect on the final irrigation solution
rationale: A higher source-water EC indicates a higher total dissolved-ion contribution. That change should be considered when interpreting the final feed and root-zone measurements.
